component.name: 2ksbox
component.summary: Run Windows 98, XP and DOS machines

description.p: 2ksbox runs Windows 98, Windows XP and DOS the way the machines of the era did. Period 3D games run accelerated on your GPU, the picture goes through a CRT shader, and the CD-ROM drive runs raw dumps of the discs you own, copy protection included.

The launcher keeps a library of machines and creates each one from a short form with defaults for its family. Every machine shares one shelf of disc images, discs can be swapped while a machine runs, and the launcher takes snapshots. Each machine opens in its own player window.
